<thought>From the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (exact monoisotopic mass = 234.1256 Da, within a few ppm). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C14H18O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
